parent_spec.role: The parent evaluation established the frozen agreement metrics (ARI_branch, NMI_area) and produced harness_verdict=INCONCLUSIVE_POSITIVE_CONTROL_FAILED on the PRODUCT label artifacts. This addendum reconciles the accepted factory-direction headline with those artifacts.

accepted_headline_under_test.text: 3 text-based TF-IDF modes at full 173,963 have fine_branch_purity 0.906-0.930 (factory direction v35; audit CYCLE_38023784349)

questions.R1_metric_reconciliation: Reproduce the ACCEPTED purity metric on the PRODUCT artifacts and test whether it equals the accepted 0.906-0.930 headline.
questions.R2_alignment_test: Use a size-matched permutation null (shuffled labels) to test whether the PRODUCT artifacts' branch/area agreement is above chance, i.e. distinguish 'genuinely weak macro-alignment' from 'random/misaligned join'.
questions.R3_source_isolation: Re-run the frozen v29 hierarchical_v1 clustering on the EVALUATION-v25 embeddings for the 3 text modes and compute BOTH the accepted purity metric AND ARI_branch on the same labels, isolating whether the purity discrepancy is driven by embedding provenance or by the clustering code.

metric_definitions_frozen.accepted_purity_unweighted: mean over non-empty clusters (label != -1) of (dominant valid branch count / valid branch count in cluster), where valid excludes null and 'unknown'
metric_definitions_frozen.accepted_purity_weighted: sum over clusters of dominant valid branch count / total valid branch count (size-weighted analogue of accepted metric)
metric_definitions_frozen.ARI_branch: sklearn.adjusted_rand_score(human_branch, cluster_label) on rows with valid branch AND label != -1
metric_definitions_frozen.NMI_area: sklearn.normalized_mutual_info_score(human_legal_area, cluster_label, average_method='arithmetic') on rows with valid legal_area AND label != -1
metric_definitions_frozen.chance_branch_weighted: sum over the 4 branch classes of (p_class)^2, computed on the valid-branch subset
metric_definitions_frozen.permutation_null: shuffle the cluster label array uniformly at random (preserves cluster sizes), N_PERM=30, seed=12345; report null mean/std, z and empirical p for ARI_branch, NMI_area, accepted_purity_unweighted and accepted_purity_weighted

config_frozen_for_R3.note: Exactly the config frozen in hierarchical_v1_frozen_spec.json (direction v29). Reproduces the accepted pipeline, not a new method.

decision_rules_frozen.R1_provenance_mismatch_confirmed: For at least 2 of the 3 text modes, PRODUCT accepted_purity_unweighted differs from the accepted headline value by > 0.20 absolute.
decision_rules_frozen.R2_product_agreement_weak_but_above_chan: PRODUCT ARI_branch for all structurally-usable levels < 0.10 AND permutation-null p<0.05 for accepted_purity_weighted (observed above shuffled-label null).
decision_rules_frozen.R2_product_agreement_at_chance: PRODUCT accepted_purity_weighted is within 2 null std of the shuffled-label null for the production default mode (cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5_174k).
decision_rules_frozen.R3_source_driven: R3 reproduced accepted_purity_unweighted >= 0.85 for all 3 text modes on the evaluation embeddings while PRODUCT accepted_purity_unweighted < 0.60; AND R3 ARI_branch on those same reproduced labels is < 0.10 (micro-pure/macro-unaligned) OR >= 0.10 (indicating a PRODUCT join/alignment defect).
decision_rules_frozen.action_if_R1_confirmed: Annotate the accepted 0.906-0.930 headline as provenance-specific to the evaluation-v25 embeddings with the run_hierarchical_v1 pipeline; report product-artifact values as the production truth. Do NOT overwrite the historical accepted verdict JSON.
decision_rules_frozen.action_if_R3_ari_high: Raise a data-integrity blocker on product_integration_174k embedding->metadata alignment (embeddings 175440 vs metadata 173963) for the corpus/product lanes; do not promote any agreement-based claim until resolved.

falsification: If R3 shows the evaluation-embedding hierarchies ALSO have ARI_branch < 0.10, the conclusion is that TF-IDF hierarchical modes are micro-coherent but do not recover human top-level branch partition structure (a negative but valid scientific result). If R3 shows ARI_branch >= 0.10 on evaluation embeddings while product embeddings show ~0, the dominant explanation is a PRODUCT alignment/provenance defect, not a scientific property.
notes: Metrics, config, sample and rules frozen before running any R1/R2/R3 computation in this cycle. No threshold will be relaxed after observing results. The pre-existing permutation script fractal_map/permutation_null_tfidf_hierarchy_v1.py (authored after the parent eval, fixed seed 12345) is reported only as a diagnostic; R2 here is a fresh, pre-registered definition.
